item.title: Mueller pleased to earn his first podium for Porsche
item.description: Despite starting from pole, Nico Mueller wasn’t too disheartened to miss out on the Miami E-Prix win as he got his first podium for Porsche’s factory team.

item.title: Crowdstrike by APR wins opening Asian Le Mans race in Dubai
item.description: After winning the Rolex 24 At Daytona last weekend, the Crowdstrike Racing by APR team finished off a superb week, with Louis Deletraz powering to the front of the field in the final quarter hour to take the checkered flag and stand on the podium with teammates George Kurtz and Malthe Jakobs.

item.title: Formula E Evo Sessions for celebrity influencers set to return
item.description: Evo Sessions is a unique event in which influencers, content creators and celebrities get the chance to drive Formula E’s GEN3 Evo cars, with each participant being aligned with one of the championship’s competing teams.

item.title: Inside the SCCA: A new home for the Runoffs
item.description: In this special episode of the Inside the SCCA podcast, host Brian Bielanski is joined by SCCA’s Eric Prill to announce the location for the 2027 and '28 Runoffs.

item.title: Eriksson, Envision team encouraged by progress in Miami
item.description: Already on a high from his best qualifying result to date, Joel Eriksson remained with the breakaway lead pack to eventually bring home his Envision Racing car fourth.

item.title: IndyCar announces Freedom 250 GP of Washington, D.C. as 18th race
item.description: The IndyCar Series has expanded its 17-race calendar for 2026 to include a brand-new street race around Washington, D.C. as part of the country’s 250th birthday celebrations.

item.title: Crowdstrike doubles up in Dubai
item.description: The No. 4 Crowdstrike Racing by APR ORECA-Gibson completed a sweep of the two Asian Le Mans Series races in Dubai with a thrilling 4-hour battle in which all three classes had winning margins of less than two seconds.

item.title: F2 champ Drugovich still looking for a Formula E breakthrough after Miami mishap
item.description: A collision with Antonio Felix da Costa took the 2022 Formula 2 champion out of the running, but the Brazilian feels he's finding his feet in Formula E with the Andretti team.

item.title: Formula E drivers want a longer Miami track
item.description: Miami E-Prix winner Mitch Evans described the layout of the Miami International Autodrome used for the first time in Formula E over the weekend as “a challenge” and admitted he would have liked a longer lap.

item.title: Clash postponed again, until midweek
item.description: The Cook Out Clash at North Carolina's Bowman Gray Stadium has been postponed by a few more days, with NASCAR now aiming for Wednesday, Feb. 4.
